entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [API Proposal]: Extend existing search/lookup/comparison Span and ReadOnlySpan APIs with missing TComparable/TEquatable-based overloads #128821
  • `BlockExpression` with more then five expressions can be mutated after creation. #128813
  • [ci-scan-feedback] Strengthen do-not-disable detection and cross-pipeline dedup #128812
  • [aw] No-Op Runs #128810

Closed

  • [ci-scan] Test failure: X509Certificate2CollectionRemoveRangeArray under crossgen2 R2R #128815
  • JIT: Invalid runtime async result on arm64 #127605
    11.0.0

Created

    area-System.Security
